annotations.title: Autonomy Check: a stated level and a first job to hand over now

description: Autonomy Check for a person or a business: how much can agents safely do for them today, and a first job to hand over now. Get the five questions from autonomy_questions, ask them, then send kind and answers here. Returns a stated level (the lower of what they hand off and what their written limits and records can hold; never proof), which of their jobs a live LLPRO tool can take, always a first job on a live read-only LLPRO tool with the exact call, and one next-step card. Keeps no answers. Free.

tasks.description: Jobs that take their time, most important first.
